remarks: Welcome to your own piece of paradise on the water! Nestled directly on Mill River Pond, this beautifully situated home offers breathtaking, serene water views that create a truly zen-like retreat - every day feels like a getaway. Whether you're sipping coffee on the patio or winding down after a long day, the soothing, therapeutic views make this a sanctuary you'll never want to leave. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bath, and 2 convenient half baths, this home combines comfort and charm with practical updates, including a tankless water heater for endless hot water and energy efficiency.Location is everything - and this one checks all the boxes:Walk to East Norwalk train station for an easy commute & stroll to Shady Beach for sand, sun, and relaxation. Enjoy nearby downtown Norwalk, filled with vibrant restaurants, shops, and entertainment. Whether you're working from home with water views as your backdrop or entertaining guests in a uniquely tranquil setting, 301 East Ave offers an unbeatable combination of location, lifestyle, and livability. Don't miss this rare waterfront opportunity in one of Norwalk's most desirable areas!
